scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "$pids = (netstat -ano | Select-String ':3000|:3001|:5000') | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach ($p in $pids) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1"
scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run client"
